goal: Name a strength and support it with a short example.

phrases.example: One of my strengths is being organised.
For example, I always finish my work on time.

phrases.text: People often say that I am ...

meaning.roman: Log aksar kehte hain ke main ... hoon.

phrases.example: People often say that I am a good listener.

roleplay.model_answer: One of my strengths is being organised. I make a plan before I start any task.

roleplay.tutor_line: Can you give me an example?

task.roman: Apni khubi ki ek chhoti misaal dein.

roleplay.model_answer: For example, at university I made a weekly plan for my assignments, and I submitted all of them on time.

roleplay.tutor_line: What would your friends or teachers say about you?

task.roman: Batayein ke log aap ke baare mein kya kehte hain.

roleplay.model_answer: People often say that I am a good listener. My friends tell me that I stay calm when there is a problem.

roleplay.tutor_line: How would you describe yourself in one sentence?

task.roman: Apne aap ko ek jumle mein bayan karein.

roleplay.model_answer: I am a patient person and I enjoy learning new things.

roleplay.tutor_line: Which of your strengths is most useful for this kind of work?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap ki kaun si khubi is kaam mein sab se zyada kaam aati hai, aur misaal dein.

roleplay.model_answer: One of my strengths is staying calm. For example, I can talk to an angry customer politely and look for a solution.
